company_name: Xiamen Hengkun New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential materials for core chip manufacturing processes, including front-end lithography and thin-film applications.
summary: Xiamen Hengkun New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is a key supplier of semiconductor materials, focusing on the R&D and production of materials crucial for front-end lithography and thin-film processes in IC manufacturing. Their products support the production of DRAM, 3D NAND, MOSFETs, and logic devices, ensuring supply chain stability and production security for their customers.
